scientific_integrity: Exact finite transition and spectral checks independently reproduced using the included standard-library script; all infinite-limit statements rest on the stated analytical proof. Numerical experiments are not substituted for proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified flower-cactus family with fixed alpha and exponential long-cycle count is proved; the single plateau-level mixing threshold is unresolved. General heterogeneous product-chain priority and inaccessible Mohamed full text remain research limitations. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Two-stage mixing without cutoff in cactus spanning-tree rewiring
